canonicalStep.title: postcat-connector-bracket-underside (BMW 328i draft Oxygen Sensor guide; evidence step 11)

elements.describe: The underbody splash shield below the transmission that is removed to reach the sensors.
A small bracket at the bottom of the transmission bell housing that holds the two post-cat sensor plugs.
Two monitor sensors in the exhaust pipe behind the catalytic converters, each wrapped in an insulating foil shield.
Clips that hold the sensor harness, released when the plugs are disconnected.
